scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend --if-present -- --run && npm run test --workspace frontend --if-present -- --run
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend --if-present && npm run lint --workspace frontend --if-present
